type Json = string | number | boolean | null | JsonArray | JsonObject;
interface JsonArray extends Array<Json> {}
interface JsonObject { [k: string]: Json }
const bad1: Json = { a: [1, () => 1] };
interface NumArr extends Array<number> {}
const bad2: NumArr = ["a"];
const s: string[] = ["a"];
const bad3: NumArr = s;
interface RTree extends ReadonlyArray<RTree | number> {}
const rt: RTree = [1, [2, [3]]];
interface MTree extends Map<string, MTree> {}
const mt: MTree = new Map<string, MTree>();
const bad4: RTree = ["x"];
const ok5: ReadonlyArray<Json> = [1, "a", [null]];
const nums: number[] = [1];
const ok6: JsonArray = nums;
const bad7: JsonArray = [undefined];
type Fn = { <T>(x: T): T; (x: number): string };
const fn1: Fn = (x: any) => x;
const fn2: { <T>(x: T): T[] } = <U>(x: U) => x;
console.log(rt, mt, ok5, ok6, fn1, fn2);
